program export_pressure_mesh
use meshs
implicit none
integer n,j
call mpi_precompute()
call par_precompute()
call mes_precompute()
open(91,file='radius.dat',status='new')
do n=1,i_N
write(91,'(2es26.17)') mes_D%r(n,1),mes_D%intrdr(n)
end do
close(91)
open(91,file='bands.dat',status='new')
do n=1,i_N
do j=max(1-i_KL,n-i_KL),min(i_N,n+i_KL)
write(91,'(2i8,2es26.17)') n,j,mes_D%dr(1)%M(i_KL+1+n-j,j),mes_D%dr(2)%M(i_KL+1+n-j,j)
end do
end do
close(91)
end program export_pressure_mesh
payload.scope: Native unconstrained radial operators; no time evolution or pressure boundary-row export
